name: Flexential Salt Lake City - Fair Park

source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
Flexential Salt Lake City - Fair Park publishes 22,539 square feet of technical space and no IT load figure in megawatts. Without a published power number, no translation into racks or accelerators is possible. The campus's AI relevance cannot be sized from the operator's own page as it stands today.

The four certifications define what workloads this facility is qualified to host. SOC 1 Type 2 and SSAE 18 address controls over financial reporting processes. SOC 2 Type 2 covers security, availability, and related trust principles for service organizations. HITRUST qualifies the campus for regulated healthcare data. Together they point toward compliance-sensitive enterprise workloads rather than toward hyperscale AI training, though nothing in the published data confirms or rules out any specific tenant or use.

Among the 21 Utah data center facilities this site has mapped, only three publish a megawatt figure at all, totaling 39 MW across those three. This campus ranks fourth by published megawatts, which in practice means it publishes no megawatt figure and sits below all three facilities that do. Utah's 39 MW of published capacity is a thin base for AI infrastructure at state scale, and Fair Park's contribution to that number, as far as the operator's page discloses, is zero.
